title: Ethiopian Street Food Platter
localName: የጎዳና ምግብ ሳህን — Ye-Godana Mgib Sahin
community: All of Ethiopia — the complete street food experience
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Street Food Platter — Sambusa (ETH161), Dabo Kolo (ETH162), Berbere Chicken Wings (ETH189), Roasted Chickpeas (ETH163), Spiced Peanuts (ETH164), Sesame Brittle (ETH174), and Silsi with Awaze for dipping. The complete Ethiopian street food experience assembled as a sharing platter.
longDesc: The Ethiopian Street Food Platter brings together the full range of Ethiopian street food onto one sharing board — the fried, the roasted, the sweet, the savoury, and all the condiments that make them complete. It is Ethiopia's street food culture translated to the party and restaurant format.
steps: Prepare ahead: Dabo Kolo (keeps weeks), roasted chickpeas and peanuts (keeps weeks), sesame brittle (keeps weeks).
Day of: marinate chicken wings (2 hours minimum).
Hour before: make sambusa and silsi.
Arrange on a large board: hot items in the centre, snacks around, dips in small bowls.
chefTips: The dry snacks can all be made well in advance — only the sambusa and wings need day-of preparation.
Serve the sambusa the instant they come out of the oil.
Arrange by texture: crispy items together, snacks together, sweet together.
commonMistakes: Serving sambusa cold — must be immediate.
sustainabilityTips: Ethiopian street food uses predominantly local ingredients — very low food miles.
storage: Dry items keep weeks. Fresh items: eat immediately.
healthBenefits: The variety of the platter provides protein (sambusa, wings, chickpeas), healthy fats (peanuts, sesame), and complex carbohydrate (dabo kolo) — a surprisingly nutritionally balanced spread.
culturalNote: The Ethiopian Street Food Platter is a celebration of the country's most democratic food tradition — the food that is available to everyone, that is eaten standing at stalls, that fuels the energy of Ethiopian market life. To share this platter is to share the experience of Ethiopian street culture.
